strongSaveTheseWords: Save these 24 words now. They are the only way to open your locked files if you lose this device. They are shown once, and nobody can find them for you, not even us.
nowPasteThemInto: Now paste them into a file and keep it somewhere safe.
copyThemAndStore: Copy them and store them in a file on your computer, somewhere safe.
typeTheseWordsFrom: Type these words from your copy, to show they are saved:
yourKeyIsSaved: Your key is saved on this device and checked when you press Save.
cancelMakesNoKey: Cancel makes no key. You can make one later under Settings → Keys.
thisBrowserCannotKeep: This browser cannot keep an encryption key (it needs a secure connection, and storage that is not blocked). Use another browser, or the app.
yourKeyIsReady: ✓ Your key is ready on this device.
yourFriendsSeeThis: Your friends see this code in your shared safebox, under Advanced. They can compare it with this one, in person or by phone, to be sure it is really your key.
filesInYourSafebox: Files in your safebox will be locked with a key that stays on your device, so that only you and your friend can read them, not even the service. This makes the key and gives you 24 recovery words to keep.
theKeyCouldNot: The key could not be made. Try again.
theKeyCouldNot2: The key could not be saved. Try again.
